## What changed

Describe the user-visible or technical change.

## Why

Explain the problem this solves and any trade-offs.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass
- [ ] New behavior has a regression test or reproducible example
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or interfaces changed
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated secrets, or unrelated files are included

## Evidence

Paste the exact commands, outputs, fixtures, or benchmark details used to verify the change.
